name: C063 Kẻ Thì Thầm (Quyền Trượng Đàn Cốt Cầm)
prompt_ref:
Create a single-cell 1x1 reference sheet of a dark-fantasy Whisperer's bone-lyre scepter staff (Quyền Trượng Đàn Cốt Cầm - C063 Kẻ Thì Thầm) following the exact square cell of the attached reference layout_guide_1x1.png.

COMPOSITION & ORIENTATION (100% MANDATORY):
- Draw ONE complete bardic bone-lyre staff oriented DIAGONALLY from bottom-left (dark bronze and carved bone shaft) to top-right (a horned skull-and-ribcage lyre frame strung with glowing golden-amber acoustic strings).
- Must show 100% of the entire staff from bottom tip to top bone-lyre head with generous padding inside the frame (occupying 65%-75% of the canvas).
- Zero clipping at canvas edges.

COLOR & BACKGROUND (100% MANDATORY):
- Background MUST be flat solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) edge-to-edge.
- DO NOT use any magenta/pink tones on the staff itself (use aged ivory bone, dark antique bronze, crimson leather grip, and warm amber-gold strings).
- No character hands, no text, no borders.
prompt_card:
Create a wide horizontal 16:11 dark-fantasy card illustration featuring the exact same Bone-Lyre Whisperer Staff (Quyền Trượng Đàn Cốt Cầm - C063 Kẻ Thì Thầm) from the attached reference image.

COMPOSITION & BACKGROUND (100% MANDATORY):
- Place the bone-lyre scepter staff diagonally across the center of the horizontal frame.
- Full atmospheric dark-fantasy background (100% opaque RGB illustration, NO magenta, NO transparency): a shadowy catacomb amphitheater where golden-amber musical soundwaves and battle-frenzy runes vibrate from the bone lyre strings.
- Do NOT draw any card frame, borders, or text.
